heading: Educators Urge Sun Prairie School Board to Address Pay Gap
summary: Sun Prairie educators urged the school board to follow through on compensation commitments they said were made during the 2024 referendum campaign. Speakers said professional educators' salaries had fallen 3.15% below the Dane County average and argued that better pay is needed to recruit and retain teachers. They asked the district to use available salary funding for a supplemental increase. The concerns were raised during public comment at the Nov 23 meeting.

heading: School Board Adopts Legislative Agenda Focused on Funding
summary: The Sun Prairie school board adopted its 2026-27 legislative agenda ahead of the next state legislative session. Board members emphasized stronger state school funding, including special education support and increases that keep pace with inflation. They said improving those funding sources could free up district money for salaries and benefits. Members also discussed coordinating advocacy with other Dane County school districts.

heading: Wisconsin Reports Third Death Linked to Measles Outbreak
summary: Wisconsin health officials reported an adult Lafayette County resident's death associated with the ongoing measles outbreak, bringing the outbreak's death toll to three. The Department of Health Services reported 918 cases and 19 hospitalizations among residents of 24 counties since August, as of Nov 24. The agency said it is coordinating case investigations, testing and vaccination efforts with local and Tribal health departments. DHS said it will skip its Nov 27 data update and resume regular updates Dec 1.
